title: Canonical auth-contract drift diagnostic — baseline vs P2.5.1 head
body:
Related: #1276 / Draft PR #1277. Coordination: #1209 / #1212.

## Purpose

Diagnose one Full Canonical integration failure that currently blocks deciding evidence for PR #1277.

PR #1277's focused P2.5.1 artifact qualification passed, but its single exact-head Full Canonical run failed in the existing unchanged auth contract test:

`scripts/test-codex-isolated-auth-projection.ts --contracts`

Observed assertion location:
`runtimePolicyNegativesV01`, around the `auth-recovery-runtime-drift` probe.

The test expected:
- `authRecovery.result === null`
- `errorCodeV01(authRecovery.error) === "codex_isolated_auth_runtime_policy_drift"`

The actual run instead received a failed result/receipt carrying the same runtime-policy-drift reason.

No source owner implicated by that auth contract was changed in #1277.

This issue is diagnostic first. Do not weaken the test, narrow Canonical, retry the failed exact-head Full Canonical run for a pass, or merge #1277 based only on focused evidence.

## Relevant source identities

PR #1277:
- base: `7597ed20e41f8ca9641eb3b0e08d0612b6a0d89a`
- base tree: `8ec95432fee952f648c66213a9b30a29480e3522`
- head: `7b755cabc741a65a0cefcc440ae25659167a35a5`
- head tree: `aae25f782ccb581cca13d3323ce46284d3501716`

The base tree equals the already-qualified source tree from the preceding invocation-signal correction before merge. That historical pass is useful context only; current ambient behavior must be measured directly.

## Diagnostic questions

1. Under the same current Mac/runtime/toolchain conditions, does the exact auth-contract probe fail identically on both:
   - base `7597ed20...`
   - head `7b755cab...`

2. If both fail identically:
   - is the failure reproducibly independent of the P2.5.1 changed files?
   - did the observable auth-runtime behavior drift from "throw/no result" to "bounded failed result carrying the same stop reason"?
   - which current owner/runtime version is responsible?

3. If only head fails:
   - identify the exact dependency/import/runtime path by which #1277 affects the auth contract before proposing any fix.

4. Does the present behavior preserve the intended safety boundary:
   - failure occurs before repository work;
   - no thread/start or turn/start;
   - no auth-recovery/approval observations;
   - no state writes;
   - exact public stop reason remains `codex_isolated_auth_runtime_policy_drift`?

## Required method

Use a non-deciding differential diagnostic. Do not run another exact-head Full Canonical attempt.

Prefer the smallest existing contract/probe entry point that reproduces this exact scenario.

Run the same probe under controlled current conditions against:
- A: base source `7597ed20...`
- B: PR head `7b755cab...`

If repository policy prevents switching the canonical checkout safely, use task-owned temporary source copies/worktrees only if existing repository rules permit them for diagnostics; do not alter retained data or the installed Companion outside existing maintenance owners.

Record:
- exact source identity/tree;
- exact runtime/tool version used by the probe;
- result versus thrown-error shape;
- public stop reason;
- thread/start / turn/start observations;
- auth-recovery/approval observations;
- state-directory/write accounting;
- process/listener cleanup;
- whether changed P2.5.1 files are reachable from the failing contract's transitive import/runtime path.

Do not call providers unnecessarily. No retry-until-green.

## Dispositions

Use one:

### INHERITED_RUNTIME_CONTRACT_DRIFT
Base and head fail identically under the same current environment; P2.5.1 changed files are not on the failing path; safety semantics remain intact. Then propose a separately reviewed compatibility correction for the auth contract/owner. Do not silently edit #1277 to absorb unrelated auth work.

### HEAD_INTRODUCED_REGRESSION
Head fails while base passes under controlled current conditions. Identify the causal path and return #1277 to implementation correction.

### ENVIRONMENT_INCONCLUSIVE
Current conditions cannot support a fair base/head comparison.

### OTHER
State the exact evidence.

## Merge boundary

Until this diagnostic is resolved, PR #1277 remains Draft with no valid deciding evidence.

If an inherited auth-contract drift is proven, a separate correction must restore current Local Canonical truth. After that correction merges or is otherwise incorporated into a fresh exact head, #1277 must obtain new exact-head deciding evidence according to the repository Local Canonical policy. Do not transfer the failed receipt or an older receipt onto a later head.
